entries.subject: Stellar and planetary measurements
entries.finding: Luque et al. (2023), Nature 623, 932–937, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06692-3, Extended Data Table 3: radius 0.788 +/- 0.008 solar radii, mass 0.798 +/- 0.042 solar masses, effective temperature 5266 +/- 64 K. Conversion uses 695700 km per solar radius and solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. The display axis is sky north, not a measured stellar pole. Circular orbits with the published 2023 periods and transit epochs. Planet-planet perturbations and transit-timing variations are not propagated; this is not a current transit forecast or an N-body resonance simulation. Absolute sky nodes and spin axes are unknown.

entries.subject: Resolved photosphere and spots
entries.finding: The ESPRESSO spectrum is unresolved. No texture or spot map is inferred. The darker edge is a published ATLAS9 model, not a resolved measurement.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-backed resolved product, rotational constraint or appropriate photometric model becomes available.

entries.subject: Wide stellar companions
entries.finding: Apps & Luque (2023) report HD 110067 as the wide component of a hierarchical triple. This package displays the inner six-planet system; it does not claim that the host is isolated.
entries.revisitWhen: Companion astrometry and a justified wide-system placement are prepared.

entries.subject: ESPRESSO-band limb darkening
entries.finding: Zak et al. (2024), section 4: fixed model coefficients u1=0.564 and u2=0.145 from ExoCTK ATLAS9 in 380–788 nm. Applied achromatically to the measured colour; not a fitted or resolved intensity profile.
